_comment: Single source of truth for prosthetic-conscience's local tool dependencies. Consumed by the shared toolchain probe (tools/internal/toolchain), used by both the hook binaries and /sc-doctor. See plans/claude-port-plan.md §3a'.

tools.name: git
tools.purpose: version control; the blackboard is git-tracked

tools.name: qlty
tools.purpose: format + lint quality gate (sc-quality-gate runs it)

_hook_binary._comment: sc-quality-gate is OUR compiled hook, not an external dep. /sc-doctor --fix builds it (go build, if Go is present) or fetches the prebuilt release asset for this GOOS/GOARCH into bin/. hooks.json invokes ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/sc-quality-gate.
_hook_binary.name: sc-quality-gate
